readmeExcerpt:
# nanocode

Minimal Claude Code alternative. Single Python file, zero dependencies, ~250 lines.

Built using Claude Code, then used to build itself.



## Features

- Full agentic loop with tool use
- Tools: `read`, `write`, `edit`, `glob`, `grep`, `bash`
- Conversation history
- Colored terminal output

## Usage

```bash
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="your-key"
python nanocode.py
```

### OpenRouter

Use [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) to access any model:

```bash
export OPENROUTER_API_KEY="your-key"
python nanocode.py
```

To use a different model:

```bash
export OPENROUTER_API_KEY="your-key"
export MODEL="openai/gpt-5.2"
python nanocode.py
```

## Commands

- `/c` - Clear conversation
- `/q` or `exit` - Quit

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `read` | Read file with line numbers, offset/limit |
| `write` | Write content to file |
| `edit` | Replace string in file (must be unique) |
| `glob` | Find files by pattern, sorted by mtime |
| `grep` | Search files for regex |
| `bash` | Run shell command |

## Example

```
────────────────────────────────────────
❯ what files are here?
────────────────────────────────────────

⏺ Glob(**/*.py)
  ⎿  nanocode.py

⏺ There's one Python file: nanocode.py
```

## License

MIT

aiSummary.oneLiner: A minimal, ~250 line Python alternative to Claude Code with full agentic loop capabilities.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: nanocode is a hyper-minimalist AI coding assistant designed to replicate the core functionality of Claude Code in a single, zero-dependency Python file. Despite being only ~250 lines long, it implements a complete agentic loop capable of autonomous tool use. It connects to the Anthropic API (or OpenRouter) and can execute bash commands, read, write, and edit files, and utilize tools like glob and grep. It serves as both a practical lightweight CLI tool and an educational reference for how to build a capable LLM agent from scratch without bloated frameworks.
keyFeatures: Single File Architecture: The entire application is contained in `nanocode.py`, making it trivial to audit and modify.
Zero Dependencies: Requires no external Python libraries, running purely on the standard library.
Full Agentic Loop: The AI can autonomously decide to use tools, read outputs, and chain actions to solve complex tasks.
Built-in Tools: Natively supports file manipulation (`read`, `write`, `edit`), searching (`grep`, `glob`), and execution (`bash`).
OpenRouter Support: Can easily switch from Anthropic to any model supported by OpenRouter via environment variables.

useCases.title: Agentic Architecture Study

useCases.title: Instant Deployment
useCases.description: Dropping the single script onto a remote server to have an AI assistant help configure the machine without installing pip packages.

useCases.title: Custom Agent Modification
useCases.description: Forking the single file to quickly add a custom tool (like a database query) for a specific project workflow.

useCases.title: Framework-Free Automation
useCases.description: Using an AI assistant in strict environments where installing large frameworks like LangChain is prohibited.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: nanocode is ideal for Python developers, AI researchers, and minimalists who want to understand agentic loops or need a highly portable CLI coding assistant.
